couches.description:
Grey U-Shaped Sectional Sofa

Spacious and comfortable grey U-shaped sectional with plenty of seating, perfect for larger living rooms and family spaces.

Condition: Good used condition. Fully professionally deep cleaned and ready for its new home.

Minor Imperfections: Some dog scratches on one back corner and light fabric pulling on the opposite corner. These are cosmetic imperfections and do not affect the couch's comfort or functionality. All the details are in the photos.

Delivery: Free delivery within Kitchener–Waterloo.

Contact us to schedule a viewing or arrange delivery.
